test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If Average Production is decreasing, then what will be the effect on Marginal Production?

options.text: It will have a positive slope
It will be more than Average Production
It will be less than Average Production
It will be same as Average Production

solution:
The correct answer is "**It will be less than Average Production**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **marginal product** and average product have a close relationship.
 
• The marginal product will alter the average product with each **extra unit**, and vice versa. The marginal product will decrease if the average product falls or drops.
 
• The marginal product, however, will always be **negative** or zero and be **less than the average product**.
 
• The marginal and average productivity will be impacted by changes in each unit of output.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When the average product is at its highest value, marginal product equals average product.
 
• When average product **declines**, marginal product does not rise.
 
• When the average product is declining, the marginal product will not surpass.
 
• The marginal product will fall and the **average product** will always be less than the marginal product.
